issue.title: Flaky test_save_atomically_replaces_existing_state under full parallel lane
issue.description: REPRODUCTION: During finish_flat_pane_query_migration verification on 2026-08-15, just check escalated to the governed full suite because the Justfile changed and failed tests/ace/tui/test_config_center_state.py::test_save_atomically_replaces_existing_state under the 14-worker lane. The same node passed immediately afterward in a focused rerun together with the other full-suite failure: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_procs_service.py::test_settlement_resumes_after_an_injected_crash tests/ace/tui/test_config_center_state.py::test_save_atomically_replaces_existing_state -q' -> 2 passed in 1.54s. IMPACT: unrelated agents cannot get a green just check when the full-suite lane trips this pass-isolation config-center state failure. SCOPE: reproduce under parallel/full-suite conditions, identify the state or filesystem timing dependency in config-center state persistence, and make the test deterministic without weakening its atomic replace assertion.

payload.entry:
Fixed by epic sase-ns.6 phase sase-ns.6.2, commit d9b2984a7 'fix(tui): isolate config center state replacement'. Closed by that epic's land agent because the phase worker did not perform its plan-mandated bead bookkeeping.

ROOT CAUSE (not just the symptom): the atomic-save tests monkeypatched config_center_state.os.replace. That attribute is the shared Python 'os' module object, so the patch replaced os.replace process-wide on the pytest-xdist worker for the duration of the test, and any concurrently-running test on that worker that replaced a file hit the test's assertion-bearing stub. That is why the node failed only under the full parallel lane and passed instantly in isolation, and why four unrelated agents reproduced it from diffs that never touched Config Center persistence.

FIX: save_admin_center_tab_history() now calls a module-local _replace_state_file(source, target) wrapper (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/config_center_state.py). The two atomic-save tests patch only that local seam, and the success test additionally asserts 'os.replace is real_replace' so a future regression back to a process-wide patch fails loudly. The atomic-replace assertion is intact and unweakened: the stub still verifies the temporary file holds the new content and the destination still holds the old content at replace time.

VERIFICATION: phase sase-ns.6.2 ran the focused suite 23/23 and SASE_CONTENTION_REPEAT=10 SASE_CONTENTION_WORKERS=8 'just test-contention' on the node (10/10 repeats, 0 failed nodes), and its 'just check' escalated to the full non-visual suite with the node green. Re-verified by the land agent at HEAD 6000a54a1: tests/ace/tui/test_config_center_state.py plus tests/test_bead/test_cli_work_cleanup_apply.py -> 26 passed, and 'just check' exits 0 (every lint gate plus the scoped test lane).

FLAKE BASELINE: d9b2984a7 removed the node's entry from tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, but the durable store's 21 historical failure records still tripped 'just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake'. The land agent closed that gap with a '# fixed-at: 2026-08-17T01:44:57Z' retirement entry naming this commit -- the mechanism phase sase-ns.6.1 built in the same epic. All 12 in-window failures are now retired and the node no longer appears in the gate's report.
